transcript.text: I need to flag an engineering constraint I discovered this morning. While debugging an unrelated queue-consumer issue, I measured that more than 2 concurrent inference requests can exhaust the triage worker's connection pool. When that happens, timeouts bypass the intended manual-review fallback and leave tickets without a routing label. I have not filed this in the launch ticket yet. The good news is that capping concurrency at 2 in the rollout configuration is sufficient to address this — no separate engineering deployment is needed before flag enablement. So my operational constraint is: the rollout configuration must cap inference concurrency at 2.
